premises.text: Carbon nanotube mesh filters' conductivity and surface area shrink electrochemical metal purification to coffee-cup scale
premises.evidence_span: shrink a process that used to require the size of a cubic football field down to the size of a coffee cup

premises.text: Charged nanotube filters precipitate metals from liquid solution as solid materials, separating bulk from rare earth elements
premises.evidence_span: delivering a charge across the mesh of carbon nanotube filters to try and precipitate metals contained in a liquid solution as solid materials

premises.text: Low-abundance rare earth and battery metals lack a competitive purification process like that used for copper and nickel
premises.evidence_span: for low abundance metals like the rare earth ones that are used in all of the electronics sitting in your pockets or perhaps on your wrists, there is no such competitive process

premises.text: Metal supply is concentrated in few countries that use materials in-house, creating price and access risk for manufacturers
premises.evidence_span: while there's a globally distributed need for these materials, the supply of them is focused in a small number of countries

premises.text: Short-term: reclaim metals from manufacturing effluent; long-term: digest disassembled device components into primary elements
premises.evidence_span: our short-term goal is to try to improve fabrication efficiencies in manufacture

premises.text: Filters in series recover individual metals at high purity from mixed metal waste streams
premises.evidence_span: we take these carbon nanotube filters, assemble them in series, and we can introduce a mixed metal waste solution at the top of the filter stack and individually recover those metals

premises.text: Target customers are large electronics and EV manufacturers securing metal supply chains
premises.evidence_span: if you're a large company like Apple or Google or Tesla, you care a lot about this problem

domains.name: Manufacturing and afterlife reclaim use cases

value.text: Return control of the metal supply chain to manufacturers via reclaimed metals
value.evidence_span: returns control of the metal supply chain to the manufacturer

secondary_value.text: American innovation not limited by metal supply
secondary_value.evidence_span: American innovation isn't limited by supply of metals, but by the imaginations of the innovators

causal_links.evidence_span: China reduced the supply of rare earth elements to the global markets
help them digest those individual components and reclaim the individual metals

notes: Process performance (purity/recovery, cobalt/nickel capability) folded into process premises per v1.5.1 process+performance package. Industry-lacks-process claim kept as distinct rare-earth gap (P3) because it is the motivating unmet condition for the invention, not mere framing of the same process metrics.
